lines: [mysterious, low] Only a real detective can solve this. Listen till the end.
[storytelling] Grandma got a call. 'Grandma, it's me! I'm in jail! Send three thousand dollars, fast!'
[serious] Four people were near Grandma's phone that day.
Penny says she was baking all day.
Slick says he was at the library. Reading.
The mailman says he only delivers letters.
Cousin Kevin says he's been in Hawaii all week.
[whispering] Clue: the caller said 'Grandma'... but never said his own name.
[sly, to camera] So who's lying? Comment your answer. Real detectives only.
